problem:
|  | $Y=2$ | $Y=3$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $X=1$ | $\frac{1}{2}$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ |
| $X=2$ | $\frac{1}{8}$ | $\frac{1}{4}$ |

Compute $P(X=2)$ given that the random variables $X$ and $Y$ have the joint probability mass function $f(x,y)$ shown in the table above.
worked_solution:
Using the values in the table, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=2) & =P((X,Y)\in {(2,2),(2,3)}) \\  & =P((X,Y)=(2,2))+P((X,Y)=(2,3)) \\  & =f(2,2)+f(2,3) \\  & =\frac{1}{8}+\frac{1}{4} \\  & =\frac{3}{8}.\end{aligned}
$$
